For You

WELCOME BACK · おかえり

Ready to play, learn, and laugh?
一緒に楽しく学ぼう！

Bochi turns your weekly call into a game show for two. Bolu levels up his Japanese, Chihiro sharpens his English, and every round earns points. Open it together, share the screen, and start the session.

In Japanese, Bolu becomes Boru-san (ボルさん), because Japanese has no L sound, so R steps in.

Both journeys start at Level 1, Ground Up, with no knowledge assumed, and the games serve content at your level. Every 100 XP opens the next level and unlocks new character rows, word sets, and phrase sets. You can always practice a higher level in any game, and the points still count honestly toward your journey.

Schedule with Chihiro

Pick your next 45 minute session together. Bolu is free after 7:00 PM Chicago time, and times are shown in your own time zone.

Practice Solo

No meeting needed. Pick your profile, train characters, words, and phrases on your own time, and earn XP on your own journey.

Game Modes ゲーム

Pick any mode, or run the full session plan
SESSION MODE · セッション

Your 40 Minute Game Plan

One full Bochi meeting, start to finish. Work down the list together: each phase opens the right game, and when you finish a phase, mark it done and move on. At the end you get a summary with scores, new words, and homework for next time.

Conversation Rouletteかいわルーレット

Spin for a topic. Bolu talks about it in Japanese, then Chihiro talks about it in English. Two minutes each, no pressure to be perfect. Finishing your talk earns +5 points.

TOPIC · トピック
2:00

Hiragana Heroひらがなヒーロー

Bolu's game

Ten kana per round, built for Bolu's level. Read the hiragana and pick the right romaji. Correct answers earn +10, and a streak of 3 or more adds a +5 bonus. Chihiro plays coach: cheer, hint with sounds, and keep the energy up.

ROUND COMPLETE · おつかれさま

Word Duelことばデュエル

A 12 turn head to head battle. On Bolu's turns the word is Japanese and the answers are English. On Chihiro's turns it flips: English word, Japanese answers. Correct answers earn +10. Every word you get right joins your learned list on the summary.

TURN 1 OF 12
MATCH COMPLETE · たいけつ しゅうりょう

Translate Challengeほんやくチャレンジ

One player translates out loud, the other plays judge. Bolu turns Japanese sentences into English. Chihiro turns English sentences into Japanese. Say it first, then reveal the model answer together. Judge taps Correct for +10.

Story Chainものがたりチェーン

Build a silly story together, one sentence at a time. Bolu writes in Japanese (romaji is fine too), Chihiro writes in English. Each sentence earns +2. Use a twist word to make it weird. The sillier, the better.

PICK A STORY STARTER · はじまりを えらぼう
TWIST WORDS:

Culture Quizカルチャークイズ

Trivia from Japan, the United States, and Nigeria, so both of you get home turf questions and away questions. Take turns answering. Correct answers earn +10, and every question comes with a fun fact to talk about.

Book a Bochi Session

Shadow Battleシャドーバトル

A pronunciation duel. The app plays a phrase, then both of you repeat it out loud, shadowing the sound. The partner judges whose repetition nailed it. The round winner earns +10, and a round too close to call pays +5 each. Best of 5 rounds, and the loser owes a tongue twister on the next call.

ROUND 1 OF 5

BATTLE COMPLETE · たいけつ しゅうりょう

Practice Soloひとりれんしゅう

Train on your own time, between meetings. First, pick who you are. Solo practice earns XP on your own journey and never touches the versus scoreboard. Your journey is a path of chapters: finish lessons in order, pass each chapter checkpoint, and the next chapter opens, alongside your XP levels.

WHO IS PRACTICING? · だれが れんしゅうしますか

Profiles live on this device for this visit, and your solo summary at the end is how your progress travels to your partner: copy it and send it after you practice.
